messages:
alex.p: Quick sync — partner marketplace launch checklist. Need final hero assets, partner quote, blog draft, press embargo window, landing page copy, and partner-provided pricing CTA by next Thurs. Who owns each?

maya.mktg: I can own the blog + press quotes. Jesse, can you handle embargo coordination with media list?

jesse.pr: Yep. When is the embargo window? We prefer 8am PT Wed embargo lift if partner ok.

nina.ops: Partner asked for co-branded hero PNG + SVG, logo in light/dark, and 2-line blurb. Assets due Tue COB for staging.

sam.prod: Landing page needs: hero, 3 bullets (what, how, benefits), CTA that triggers marketplace flow. Can we get UTM scheme? e.g., ?utm_source=marketplace&utm_campaign=partnerX-launch

alex.p: UTM scheme sounds good. Maya — blog draft due Tue EOD? Jesse — confirm embargo with partner and get quote by Tue as well.

maya.mktg: Can do draft by Tue EOD. Will drop a Google Doc link here later.

jesse.pr: Pinged vendor PR contact. They prefer mon-Tue review, Wed embargo lift ok. Will try secure partner quote by Mon close. Also need press kit in Drive.

nina.ops: I'll upload logos + hero to S3 staging: s3://redwood-partners/partnerX/assets. Will send read-only link.

alex.p: Perfect. Also need product screenshot + marketplace listing screenshots. Sam, can your team grab and redact internal IDs?

sam.prod: Yep — will export mock screenshots by Monday and hand to Nina.

maya.mktg: Question: do we want a joint announcement or staged? Partner prefers joint but smaller social-first push.

alex.p: Let's do joint announcement with staged amplification: first marketplace listing + blog, then paid/social the same week. Communications cadence doc: I'll create checklist.

jesse.pr: Also we need embargoed press contacts and one 'set' quote from partner legal on marketing copy. I'll chase legal.

alex.p: :thumbsup: timeline seems doable. Quick checklist I'll track: assets, quotes, blog, landing page, listing, screenshots, UTMs, press kit, scheduling.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled: marketplace listing staging push at 2026-04-08T02:00:00Z. CI build #4821.

maya.mktg: Added a calendar invite for content review Tue 10am PT. RSVP please.

nina.ops: Shared S3 link: https://s3.example.com/redwood-partners/partnerX/assets (read-only).

sam.prod: UTM snippet for marketing: /?utm_source=marketplace&utm_medium=partner-listing&utm_campaign=partnerX_launch

alex.p: Thanks everyone — will update the tracker and ping if anything slips. :rocket:
